summary: Videotron Ltd., the Quebecor Media cable and wireless subsidiary, furnished a Form 6-K containing its third-quarter 2026 Management Discussion and Analysis, the standard quarterly reporting package for a foreign private issuer. No transaction or corporate action is disclosed. Reported results include revenue of $1.25 billion (up 2.9%), adjusted EBITDA of $645.0 million (up 7.1%) and net income of $299.9 million. Net mobile additions of 136,700 led the quarter. Financing activity was limited to $200.0 million of term-loan repayment in the quarter and a further $100.0 million on October 6, 2026, leaving $100.0 million outstanding. No special-situation event to model.
